_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see applyMenuRelocations in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it, a child group targeting its own parent flattens). sections: menu-entry id -> section name (assigns a top-level leaf to a navigation section — `settings` renders it inside the NC gear-icon foldout, so genuinely-admin/config entries live under Settings instead of a duplicate top-level Administration group). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs. Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.

_settingsSectionNote: Promoted into the NC settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav) by applySettingsSection in main.js. Config/admin/integration/master-data-setup entries only; operational lists stay top-level. Pipelines (pipeline definitions/config), Integrations caption + BI export + CTI (integrations/connections), POS rollen + POS medewerkers (POS master-data/admin). KassakoppelingAuditList is an audit REPORT and stays in the main nav. AvgRequests (AVG/DSAR) and MdmDuplicates/MdmMasterEntities are EARMARKED to move out of pipelinq later: AVG-verzoeken -> OpenRegister's AVG/DSAR subsystem (admin-gated, different data model — a prior seam found pipelinq cannot cleanly consume it yet), and the MDM steward views -> the OR-MDM abstraction (not built yet). Kept in pipelinq under Settings until those OR seams land. MdmDataQuality is a data-quality DASHBOARD (a report), so it moves into the 'Reports & Compliance' group via relocations rather than the settings foldout. RestartTutorial (action:'replay-walkthrough', ADR-043) re-runs the product tour from the first step; it sits with the Help caption under Settings.
_removalsNote: Former Service group child leaves retired from the nav tree by ADR-044 cards-collapse (service-group-cards-collapse). The Service menu entry now links directly to ServiceHubOverview, which renders one CnCard per former leaf. All page routes (/requests, /tasks, /contactmomenten, /complaints, /projects, /my-work, /bookings, /queues, and their :id sub-routes) remain registered in the manifest for deep-linking and e2e coverage (REQ-NAV-003).
